units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 49:17">Targ. Y. Gen. XLIX, 17</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:16:1">Cant. R. to V, 16</cite> <he>כד אתא מיתלי ע׳ מן ארעא</he> when he (Abraham) began to lift his heel from the ground (from the time he attempted to walk).—Pl. <he>עִקְּבִין</he>, <he>עִקְּבֵי</he>, <cite ref="P00072"><he>עִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 3:15">Targ. Y. I Gen. III, 15</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 10:32">Targ. Is. X, 32</cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 52a">Ḥull. 52ᵃ</cite> <he>ע׳ דגפי</he> the curved ends of the wings (where they are attached to the body).

senses.gloss: (v. preced.) end, future. Targ. Y. I Gen. l. c.; Targ. Y. II ib. עֵקֶב (constr.).
